text:
If you've got the afternoon open, this is the one to grab. It's mostly clear out there right now with low humidity and a light north wind, and Burlington should just build on that through the afternoon toward a high near 78. The one asterisk: the Euro's been running wetter for today, calling for a real shot at a shower, while our official forecast and the other models keep this dry — the AFD's read is that any showers stay clipped to southern Vermont, and I'd bet that way too, but don't be shocked by a passing sprinkle.

The lake stays sunny with light northwest wind under 10 knots most of the day, waves just 1 to 2 feet, so it's a good one to be out on the water — winds pick up a bit late, into the 10 to 15 knot range, so plan any paddling or small-boat time before early evening. Water's a comfortable 76. Once the sun dips, temperatures drop fast into the 60s, so grab a layer for anything after dinner. Good waterfront window through about 6, and Saturday looks like more of the same.
